schema.description: Level-3 MOM ProcessSegment (ISA-95 Part 2 / B2MML ProcessSegment). Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/process-segment.md, description.

process_segment_no.description: Identity of the ProcessSegment (join key). Recommendation: path- / Function-prefixed, since Function codes are unique per line.

process_segment_code.description: Raw segment / Function code from the naming source (the function naming standard Table 1 / the MES 'plant' code).

name.description: Display name of the manufacturing stage (e.g. a forming, dosing, or curing stage).

operations_type.description: ISA-95 'Mixed Operation Schedule' classification of the stage. Corresponds to the momDomain.

sequence.description: Sequence of the stage within the OperationsDefinition (routing).

duration_planned_sec.description: Planned stage duration (s) as a capability default; overridden by the SegmentRequirement in the concrete order.

operations_definition_ref.description: FK to OperationsDefinition.operations_definition_no (PART_OF). The routing to which this stage belongs.

unit_ref.description: FK to Machine.machine_id (SPECIFIES_EQUIPMENT; Machine ≡ Unit level). The ISA-88 Unit / process stage on which the segment runs — the physical anchoring of the 'plant' / 'Function'.

relationships.description: The OperationsDefinition (routing) that sequences this stage.
The Machine (≡ Unit level, consolidation 2026-07-15; = plant = Function) on which the segment is executed.

isa95.note: ISA-95 Part 2 ProcessSegment = reusable manufacturing stage. Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/process-segment.md, isa95 › note.
isa95.mappingNote: B2MML carries a duration on OperationsSegment and SegmentRequirement, not on ProcessSegment.
